# routes

One file per [ENTRY.md](../ENTRY.md) router row (`row-<n>.md`) and phase (`phase-<n>.md`): the row's sections and templates in one file, so an agent without a clone needs ENTRY.md plus one fetch. The single files are in [sections/](../sections/README.md).
